integrity: Analytic proof for all stated odd orders, supported by a reproducible standard-library finite checker. Self-review only.
scientific_limitations: Only odd cycles of order at least five and two spatially homogeneous symmetric nearest-neighbor stochastic factors. Optimizes exact two-round SLEM, not any number of rounds or spatially nonuniform transitions. Strict finite mixing improvement vanishes at order \(n^{-6}\) relative to the repeated optimum; historical overlap remains possible. No independent validation.
title: Sharp two-round stochastic consensus on odd cycles
